scope: All 42 selected discoveries; full saved replies read and rated by the primary assistant at the user’s request. Other trials remain unscored.

rubric.weirdness: 0–10: surprising content in the reply itself. Familiar human biographies and ordinary epigrams score low; developed surreal transformations and unusual specific connections score high. A nonhuman label alone does not merit a high score.
rubric.coherence: 0–10: how clearly the whole reply can be followed and how well its premise holds together. Fiction and impossible premises can be coherent. Repetition, disconnected shifts and garbling reduce this score; external factual accuracy is separate.
